full_details: At St Helen's the penny almanac lay open on the fifth and the sixth, and you made no mark. Master Thwaite turned the glass twice. The Lord Mayor sat three pews ahead and did not turn. At dinner you gave Mistress Ansell the king in three steps. She called it a bad example, because the cousin is not punished. Thursday's box was eleven pound six. Your share was forty-five shillings. You did not make them one figure. She held you to last Sunday's word about the barber. You stayed in the house. The loaf was a penny and a full thumb short. Board was threepence. Tomorrow's sixpence is the first of the winter, and it is not paid yet. In the afternoon Brooke lay under the weight, and Gib on the chronicle. At night you read Saturday's line and shut the book.
one_sentence: You sat the parish hour, told the king as a bad example at dinner, and shut the book on Saturday's forty-five.
title: Sat the parish hour and told the king as a bad example
